//: Copy to .blastradius.json in your repo root. BlastRadius auto-loads it. All keys optional.
//ignore_vectors: Suppress an entire detector class you've reviewed and accept.
//severity_overrides: Set a vector's baseline severity. Code-behaviour amplifiers can still escalate ABOVE it — policy can raise a floor but not silence a live RCE.
//custom_rules: Your own regex detectors — the open version of 'custom detectors'.

custom_rules.title: Production infra command in a repo script
custom_rules.pattern: kubectl apply|terraform apply|helm upgrade|aws s3 sync
custom_rules.trigger: CI or an AI agent running the script
custom_rules.danger: Mutates production infrastructure without a human gate.
custom_rules.remediation: Require manual approval before infra-mutating commands run.
